purpose: Only SysAdmin/SuperAdmin trigger a manual backup
preconditions: Sessions for a sysadmin and for a student; a reachable repository
action_or_input: Trigger manual backup as sysadmin; then as student
expected_result: SysAdmin's trigger succeeds; the student's is refused and no backup row is created

purpose: A manual trigger captures the current timestamp and artifacts
expected_result: A backup row exists with started_at current and the artifact captured

purpose: The dump is saved with its timestamp
expected_result: The dump artifact is saved and referenced with its timestamp

purpose: The outcome is recorded as Success or Failure
preconditions: SysAdmin session; a working and a failing repository
expected_result: First row records Success; second records Failure

purpose: A failed backup marks Failed and alerts the SysAdmin
action_or_input: Trigger a backup that cannot be created
expected_result: The row is Failed and a SysAdmin alert is queued

purpose: Automatic backups run at scheduled times without user intervention
preconditions: A due daily schedule; no actor present
action_or_input: Run the scheduled-backup job at the due time
expected_result: A scheduled backup row is created with no triggering user

purpose: Eligible datasets are identified from the applicable schedule
preconditions: A due schedule with a dataset and classification filter
expected_result: The run names the eligible dataset(s) from the effective schedule

purpose: Eligible data is transferred to backup recovery storage
preconditions: A due schedule and a reachable repository
expected_result: The artifact is written to backup storage and recorded on the row

purpose: Integrity/consistency is verified during automatic backup
expected_result: The row records integrity_verified = true after the check

purpose: The verified automatic backup is logged with timestamp and status
expected_result: The row has kind=scheduled, a started timestamp and terminal status

purpose: A scheduled run executes only when the repository is scheduled and reachable
preconditions: A due schedule pointing at an unreachable repository
expected_result: No successful transfer; the failure is recorded

purpose: Schedules are visible to an authorized SysAdmin only
preconditions: Existing schedules; SysAdmin and plain-user sessions
expected_result: The SysAdmin sees them; the plain user is refused

purpose: A SysAdmin creates/modifies a local schedule (frequency, time, filters)
action_or_input: Create a local daily schedule; then modify its run time
expected_result: Both succeed; the row carries frequency, time and filters

purpose: Invalid/conflicting schedule configurations are rejected unapplied
preconditions: An active local schedule for dataset D at 02:00
action_or_input: Submit a conflicting second schedule and one with an unknown frequency
expected_result: Both refused; no schedule row or change results

purpose: A validated schedule is applied
expected_result: The schedule row exists and is active

purpose: Each schedule configuration change is logged
expected_result: A change-log entry records the modification

purpose: Backup status and history are maintained
expected_result: All rows with status/history are returned

purpose: Users and authorized administrators view backup history in scope
preconditions: Backup rows; a plain user and a sysadmin
expected_result: Both see the history; a user without the module grant is refused

purpose: An authenticated user can initiate a secure archival request
preconditions: An authenticated user in the module
action_or_input: Submit an archival request with required metadata
expected_result: The request is created and routed for HoD review

purpose: The request captures name, date, owners, type, reason and attachment
expected_result: The stored request carries every stated field

purpose: Submission is validated; failure shows errors and changes nothing
preconditions: Incomplete metadata; a user over quota
action_or_input: Submit an invalid request and an over-quota request
expected_result: Both refused with errors; no request row or state change

purpose: A successful submission sets status Submitted
expected_result: The request's status is Submitted

purpose: A submitted request routes to the requester's HoD
preconditions: A submitted request in department D; the HoD of D
action_or_input: The HoD lists their review queue
expected_result: The request appears in the routed HoD's queue

purpose: The routed HoD can review details/attachments before deciding
action_or_input: Fetch the request detail as the HoD
expected_result: Details and attachments are visible to the routed HoD

purpose: The HoD approves/rejects and the decision is recorded
action_or_input: Approve one and reject the other
expected_result: Statuses move accordingly and both decisions are recorded

purpose: Only the requester's-department HoD may decide
preconditions: A request in department D; the HoD of a different department
action_or_input: The foreign HoD attempts the decision
expected_result: Refused; the request is unchanged

purpose: After HoD approval the request routes to the SysAdmin
action_or_input: The SysAdmin lists the classification window
expected_result: The approved request is visible for classification

purpose: The SysAdmin classifies as Critical/Sensitive/Routine/Archival
expected_result: Each accepted classification is stored as authoritative

purpose: No initial classification defaults to Routine
preconditions: A submission without an initial classification
expected_result: The stored initial classification is Routine

purpose: Security and retention rules follow the authoritative classification
expected_result: The request carries the Sensitive retention rule

purpose: A Sensitive classification routes the request to IT Security
expected_result: Status becomes routed to IT Security for encryption

purpose: IT Security can configure encryption for Sensitive data
preconditions: A routed_to_security request; IT Security session
expected_result: The configuration succeeds and is recorded

purpose: After encryption is configured the encrypted archive is created and recorded
expected_result: An encrypted archive artifact is created and the outcome recorded

purpose: Sensitive data uses AES-256 at rest and in transit
expected_result: The recorded algorithm is AES-256 (at rest and in transit)

purpose: A user tracks status/history of their archival request
action_or_input: Fetch the request and its history as the owner
expected_result: Status and decision history are visible to the owner

purpose: Submission and decision notifications are sent at the relevant stages
preconditions: A submission then a HoD decision
expected_result: The requester's queue gains the submission and decision notifications

purpose: The Super Admin performs a special archival operation
preconditions: Super Admin session; an offline request
expected_result: The operation succeeds and is recorded

purpose: Only the Super Admin may perform special archival
action_or_input: Both attempt the special archival operation
expected_result: Both attempts are refused

purpose: The special archival records its outcome and audit event
action_or_input: Read the records and the audit log
expected_result: The outcome row and a corresponding audit event exist

purpose: A user can request restoration of archived data
preconditions: Archived data owned by the user
expected_result: The restoration request is created in the appropriate starting state

purpose: Sensitive restoration requires SysAdmin approval first
preconditions: A restoration request for Sensitive data
expected_result: Execution is refused until approval is recorded

purpose: Non-Sensitive data restores through the standard path
expected_result: The restoration completes without an approval step

purpose: A user tracks restoration-request status
expected_result: Status is visible to the owner

purpose: When the quota is full the user can submit an extension request
action_or_input: Submit an extension request with justification
expected_result: The request is created and routed to the HoD

purpose: The extension request is validated against current usage
expected_result: Refused with an explanatory error; nothing is created

purpose: A valid extension request routes to the user's HoD
preconditions: A submitted extension request; the HoD of the user's department
action_or_input: The HoD lists the extension queue
expected_result: The request appears in the routed HoD's queue

purpose: The HoD reviews details, attachment, infrastructure and justification
preconditions: A queued extension request; its HoD
action_or_input: Fetch the request and the infrastructure picture as the HoD
expected_result: The stated review inputs are visible

purpose: The HoD approves/rejects and the decision is recorded
preconditions: Two queued extension requests; their HoD
action_or_input: Approve one and reject the other
expected_result: Statuses move and both decisions are recorded

purpose: Storage thresholds are monitored for all users
expected_result: Every profile's full-quota status is refreshed

purpose: Requested storage is validated against available infrastructure
preconditions: Full-quota user; infrastructure smaller than the request
action_or_input: Submit an extension exceeding available infrastructure
expected_result: Refused with an explanatory error; nothing is created

purpose: The Super Admin defines global schedules and default policies
action_or_input: Define the global schedule as each
expected_result: The Super Admin's definition succeeds; the SysAdmin's is refused

purpose: The global schedule applies where no valid local override exists
preconditions: A global schedule; a dataset with no local schedule
action_or_input: Evaluate the effective schedule for that dataset
expected_result: The effective schedule is the global one

purpose: A local schedule overrides the global schedule for its dataset
preconditions: A global schedule and a local schedule for dataset D
action_or_input: Evaluate the effective schedule for D
expected_result: The effective schedule is the local one

purpose: Retention rules are enforced by classification
action_or_input: Classify archived data with each value
expected_result: Each carries its classification's retention rule

purpose: A failed backup alerts the SysAdmin within five minutes
expected_result: The SysAdmin alert is queued for delivery within the five-minute window

purpose: Three consecutive failures escalate to the Director of IT
expected_result: An escalation to the Director of IT is queued, exactly once

purpose: Backup status/completion notifications issue, including failure alerts
preconditions: A successful and a failed backup
expected_result: The corresponding status notification is queued

purpose: The requester is notified on extension submission and HoD decision
action_or_input: Submit; then record the HoD decision
expected_result: The requester's queue gains both notifications

purpose: Audit logs record the required event kinds with required fields
expected_result: Audit rows exist with timestamp, actor id, action and outcome

purpose: A SysAdmin can view audit logs and activity histories
preconditions: Audit rows; SysAdmin and plain-user sessions
action_or_input: Read the audit log as each
expected_result: The SysAdmin's read succeeds; the plain user's is refused

purpose: IT Security audits data-activity logs for unauthorized access
expected_result: The security audit view returns activity data

purpose: A HoD views operational reports for their own department
preconditions: Requests across two departments; the HoD of D
action_or_input: Request the report for D; then for another department
expected_result: D's report succeeds; the foreign department is refused

purpose: Operational visibility into backup operations
action_or_input: Read the backup operations summary as an authorized admin
expected_result: The summary is returned

purpose: IT Security manages user permissions through RBAC
preconditions: IT Security session; a target user
action_or_input: Grant a BADMS permission, then revoke it
expected_result: Both succeed and are recorded

purpose: IT Security defines and enforces security policies
action_or_input: Define a policy and update it
expected_result: Both succeed; the policy is stored

purpose: Role separation and departmental scope are enforced
preconditions: A HoD, a SysAdmin, an IT Security member; requests in two departments
expected_result: Each out-of-scope attempt is refused
